title: Retire the residual #232 label conflicts: names of a different form
body:
Refs #758 (deferred behind #740).

Part of #232. After #732 and the four #312 batches the label index still reported **29** rows under `conflict:different_substances`. Every one is a synonym that names a different chemical form than the record it sits on, or is not a name at all. This retypes them `REJECTED_LABEL` (provenance only; they no longer resolve, export, or enter `other`).

| token | on | what it actually names |
|---|---|---|
| `cobalt(2+) chloride`, `cobalt(II) chloride` | CoCl2 x 2 H2O, x 4 H2O (local identities), x 6 H2O tombstone | the anhydrous CHEBI:35696, enriched when the hydrates still shared that term |
| `sodium phosphate monobasic anhydrous` | NaH2PO4 x 2 H2O | the anhydrous CHEBI:37585 |
| `sodium dioxido(dioxo)molybdenum` | Na2MoO4·2H2O tombstone | the anhydrous CHEBI:75215 |
| `trisodium 2-hydroxypropane-1,2,3-tricarboxylate` | Sodium_Citrate and Trisodium_Citrate_X_2_H2o tombstones (both CHEBI:32142 dihydrate) | anhydrous trisodium citrate CHEBI:53258 |
| `CaCl2 × 2 H2O`, `CaCl2*2H2O` | Calcium_Chloride tombstone (CHEBI:3312) | the dihydrate, Cacl2_X_2_H2o |
| `a-Ketoglutaric acid` | the disodium salt hydrate | the free acid record |
| `L-glutamate` | Na-glutamate tombstone | the anion |
| `Optional ingredient` | D-fructose, Cellulose, Na-acetate, CaCO3 | a CultureMech recipe annotation |

`scripts/retire_wrong_form_names.py` verifies each token at run time against `chebi.db` and the owning record before writing. 14 records (5 tombstones), 18 tokens, 8 SSSOM rows' `other` scrubbed. **Label-index conflicts 29 → 0.** The citrate identity questions in #704 are untouched: only names ChEBI assigns to a different form move.

Review chain: receipt `issue232-wrong-form-names` (sequence 5); dispositions unchanged (1751 / 1272), synonym-only change.

## Review findings

Filed: #758 (the dihydrate record carries three monohydrate spellings, and CultureMech counts their 36 recipes, plus 4 dihydrate-spelling recipes, under anhydrous NaH2PO4). The fix, `scripts/move_nah2po4_hydrate_labels.py`, was verified locally (NaH2PO4 237 → 197, dihydrate 53 → 57, monohydrate 50 → 86) but the count refresh on `Nah2po4.yaml` hits the identity-plan pin (#740), so it ships here with the blocker documented and is not applied.

## Checks run

All local gates OK (`validate-all`, `validate-products`, `qc-sssom`, `qc-flat-coverage`, `qc-roundtrip`, `qc-duplicate-ids`, `qc-kg-microbe-node-ids`, `qc-component-partonomy`, `qc-evidence`, `check-instruction-refs`, `check-curation-targets`); `reconcile_sssom.py` in sync; visualization currency OK; indexes regenerated; both review products exported and validated from clean output directories. Full `pytest tests/`: 2757 passed, 1 failed (`test_unified_freshness::test_the_committed_snapshot_is_within_budget`, the pre-existing unified drift budget; CI's shallow checkout skips it).
